Name: Simply Aesthetic Shoes
Author: LavenderLight
TagLine: Keep the stats, change the colour.
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS]Simply Aesthetic Shoes![/font]
My farmer may be very aesthetic and cute and love to change outfits, but they're also a tough warrior. I'd get the space boots and then be stuck with purple shoes for the rest of the game because I didn't want to give up the buffs.
1.4 introduced a way to transfer the stats over but this requires running to Emily's. And also frankly, I didn't know about this when I made this mod, and it seems others may not either.

__So now, you can have the best of both worlds!__ ✨

This mod edits the stats of all footwear to match the space boots.
Comes in two versions:

1.  The default is you have to get the skull key (and thus, are at the point in the game where you have access to the space boots) for it to take effect.

2.  The second option will change the stats right away. This can be done by opening the config file and replacing "earnit" with "cheater".

Manifest.Description: Change your shoe colour without sacrificing stats!
